# Which prescriptions actually make money?

> Free calculator for independent pharmacies: what each kind of prescription really earns after drug cost, supplies, PBM claim fees, DIR fees, rejected claims, delivery and staff time. Margin by prescription type, copay for a target margin, insured vs cash, break-even prescriptions. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
